key_findings.claim: Source [S2] (www.digitalapplied.com) reports: Four distinct memory architectures have emerged for AI agents: flat vector stores, episodic page-in/page-out systems, knowledge-graph-backed stores, and hybrid combinations.
key_findings.supporting_quote: In the last twelve months, four distinct memory architectures have settled out of the noise: flat vector stores (Mem0, Zep), episodic page-in/page-out systems (Letta, MemGPT), knowledge-graph-backed stores (graph-RAG on Neo4j or TypeDB), and hybrid combinations that stitch two or three together.

key_findings.claim: Source [S2] (www.digitalapplied.com) reports: Most agent memory failures manifest as hallucinations but are actually retrieval failures determined by memory architecture choice.
key_findings.supporting_quote: Most agent memory failures look like hallucinations but they're actually retrieval failures. The architecture you pick for memory determines what your agent can and can't remember

key_findings.claim: Source [S3] (finance.yahoo.com) reports: Zendesk deployed an autonomous support agent targeting 80% issue resolution without human intervention, supplemented by co-pilot, admin, voice, and analytics agents.
key_findings.supporting_quote: The center of the new features is an autonomous support agent that Zendesk believes will solve 80% of support issues without human intervention.

key_findings.claim: Source [S5] (stonly.com) reports: Decagon's production platform uses Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) with multi-channel support across chat, email, and voice, serving enterprise customers including Notion, Duolingo, Chime, and Rippling.
key_findings.supporting_quote: Its Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs), multi-channel support across chat, email, and voice, and enterprise customer base (Notion, Duolingo, Chime, Rippling) make it a credible choice for large teams looking to automate support conversations.

key_findings.claim: Source [S1] (www.confident-ai.com) reports: Multi-turn evaluation reveals memory failures like "going in circles" and "forgetting what I just said" that single-turn evals miss, requiring regression evals for coherence drops after context compression or handoffs.
key_findings.supporting_quote: every week, their support inbox filled up with complaints about the bot "going in circles" and "forgetting what I just said."

key_findings.claim: Source [S7] (ai-workplace-tools.contentwave.net) reports: Enterprise retrieval approaches include BM25 sparse search, dense vector retrieval, hybrid sparse+dense pipelines, and LLM-native retrieval patterns balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and governance.
key_findings.supporting_quote: The market now offers multiple mature approaches—traditional sparse search (BM25), dense vector retrieval with specialized databases, hybrid sparse+dense pipelines, and growing “LLM-native retrieval” patterns
